youtube.description:
Claude Slides: build a presentation from one prompt, edit it, then export to PowerPoint or PDF. Beta, paid plans only.

Claude Slides builds a six slide deck from one prompt. Here is the exact prompt.

1. Ask - Ask for slides, with topic, audience, and slide count.
2. Review - Claude drafts real slides in the chat.
3. Edit - Click any slide to edit it directly.
4. Export - Present in Claude, or export to PowerPoint or PDF. It is not on Free.

Needs: Beta, paid plans
